name: sheaim_settler
description: a Sheaim Settler (Fall from Heaven), a small pale pioneer with violet eyes: a deep purple hooded cloak with the hood up, a dark grey tunic with a silver clasp at the throat, a brown belt with a steel buckle and leather pouches, dark grey trousers, grey boots with brown straps, a huge tan canvas backpack on his back topped with a rolled purple bedroll, an iron pail of glowing orange embers hanging from the backpack on the screen-left side, and a gnarled wooden walking staff topped with a bone skull with a glowing purple eye, held in his LEFT hand
hands: the skull-topped staff stays in his left hand on the screen-right side and his right hand on the screen-left side is an empty fist held across his belly

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear leg, torso leans back, the skull-topped staff is lifted up over the head with its skull end pointing up and back, the big backpack on his back
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and slightly crouched, the skull-topped staff cocked behind the head with its skull end hanging down behind the shoulders, the empty right fist tucked in at the belly
strike.3: swing: the front foot steps toward the lower-right, the torso whips forward, the arm sweeps over the head and the staff is level, its skull end pointing to the lower-right
strike.4: contact: staff arm fully extended toward the lower-right, the skull end of the staff smashing down-right, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, the empty right fist swung back for balance
strike.5: follow-through: the staff carries on down until its skull end nearly touches the ground at the lower-right, torso twisted, the purple hood and cloak trailing back, the backpack swinging
strike.6: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the skull-topped staff lifts back toward its upright ready angle

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (the empty right fist flung out to the left, the staff arm thrown up and out with the skull-topped staff tilted up)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further toward the upper-left, knees bent, the skull-topped staff dipping, the empty right fist still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back with the near foot, body thrown back, staff arm flung up holding the skull-topped staff high, the empty right fist drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, hooded head droops, the skull-topped staff lowering, the heavy backpack dragging at his shoulders
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the skull end of the staff resting on the ground, the empty right arm hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left onto the big backpack, the skull-topped staff slips out of the hand, legs slide forward
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left, the purple hood still up and the big backpack under his shoulders; the skull-topped staff lies on the ground at the lower-right; the ember pail lies tipped beside the backpack
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the purple bedroll and the ember pail settle
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back over the backpack, eyes closed, the purple hood on his head, the skull-topped staff on the ground beside him
